text:
carmen: Heads-up — customer reports a spike of 502s from eu-edge embeddings. Quick debug points to header trimming corner-case. PR 5011 has a minimal fix. Can we expedite? :warning:
release_mgr: paste PR + short rollback plan. We'll need ops + oncall ack for expedited path.
carmen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5011 8-byte change. Rollback = redeploy image redwood-main-2026-04-20 (approx 4m). No schema changes.
ev an: (typo) evan: +1 ran local smoke, looks safe.
sre_lead: propose 2% canary for 7m. Watch errors, p95, and kv-cache hit ratio. Pin image tag during rollout.
qa_lead: can run a quick regression test set against the canary slice once up.
ops-rotation: oncall looked at traces; matches header trimming. +1 contingent on canary health.
releasebot: CI status: all checks passed. Built image: image:redwood-hotfix-5011. To deploy: `./infra/deploy --env eu-edge --image redwood-hotfix-5011 --canary 2% --timeout 7m`
release_mgr: running now. output: ```
> ./infra/deploy --env eu-edge --image redwood-hotfix-5011 --canary 2% --timeout 7m
deploybot: job 12077 started, creating canary slice (2%)
```
deploybot: canary up (1 small instance eu-west1), healthchecks passing, tailing errors show decrease in canary.
qa_lead: kicking quick regression run against canary — running smoke-suite.
releasebot: smoke-suite results: critical flows ok, embeddings tests pass.
sre_lead: metrics after 7m: canary error-rate down ~90% for affected calls, no latency or resource regressions. Recommend promote.
release_mgr: promoting to 100% -> `./infra/promote --job 12077 --to 100%`
deploybot: promotion started. Rolling image:redwood-hotfix-5011 across eu-edge, draining old pods.
releasebot: deploy complete. All eu-edge instances now on redwood-hotfix-5011. Post-deploy: p50/p95 stable, error-rate returned to baseline.
carmen: thanks everyone for quick sign-offs. I'll backport to the stable branch and file release notes with ticket link.
ops-rotation: will monitor logs and keep alert on for 30m.
release_mgr: ticket #1221 marked expedited hotfix; rollback command documented: `./infra/rollback --env eu-edge --image redwood-main-2026-04-20` . Closing thread.
